title: Release Symphony: Console Enablement Runbook for Dashboards, Rollouts & Cost Insights
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Objective: Coordinate a cross-functional, low-friction launch for three Console UX features landing in console-2026.03: (1) New per-route dashboard layout for model/route metrics, (2) Rollouts control panel (canary/A-B/auto-fallback UI), and (3) Token-level cost breakdown insights. This ticket produces the enablement runbook, release notes draft, training plan, shiproom agenda, and post-launch observability checklist.

Scope exclusions: backend API changes are tracked in ENG-3421 (runtime routing) and are out of scope for implementation tasks here; we coordinate only user-facing messaging, docs, training, and release ops.

Success criteria: release notes published, at least two live training sessions recorded, rollout executed to 25% customers with no critical incidents, baseline dashboards collecting metrics within 24h of GA.
acceptance_criteria: Final release notes merged to docs repo and linked from Console release modal
Enablement materials (slide deck + quickstart video) uploaded to Confluence and seeded to CS/SE teams
Shiproom checklist completed and canary rollout executed with telemetry passing gates
Communication plan executed: email to admins, in-console banner, and release blog post scheduled
Rollback/runbook validated and assigned on-call rotations documented
updates: 2026-02-22: Kickoff meeting with ENG/DES/Support/Marketing — agreed on staged rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with automated rollback criteria tied to p95 latency and error-rate thresholds.

2026-02-26: Design review w/ @Sofia Alvarez — final visual spec approved; DES provided accessible color variants and microcopy for tooltips (link: https://drive.redwood.ai/designs/console-dash-rollouts-v2).

2026-03-01: Engineering readiness sync — ENG landed feature-flag hooks and a telemetry topic (route.metrics) in staging. Dependency ENG-3421 now marked feature-complete. Engineering estimated two 1-hour hotfix slots post-canary.

2026-03-04: Training plan drafted; scheduled two live sessions (2026-03-10 16:00 UTC, 2026-03-12 09:00 UTC) and one async recording for APAC. Assigned presenter: Daniel Ko. Materials location: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CONSOLE/Release+Symphony+Enablement

2026-03-07: Release notes first draft posted; PM review requested. Noted breaking change: default per-route timeframe changed to 7d (was 30d) for initial chart rendering — included migration note and opt-out steps.
2026-03-09: QA smoke tests passed in staging; telemetry dashboard template created for on-call and CS to monitor token_cost_per_request, cache_hit_rate, p95_latency, and error_rate.
2026-03-10: Communications plan finalized with Marketing. In-console banner copy approved and scheduled for 2026-03-18 00:00 UTC. Blog draft in progress (Author: Priya Patel).
comments: Priya Patel (PM): Please make sure release notes include explicit migration steps for customers who rely on 30d default — aim for a one-click toggle in the UI.
Liam Chen (Eng): Recommend holding the 25% step for 48h if cache_hit_rate drops >10% vs baseline; added as a gate in shiproom checklist.
Sofia Alvarez (Design): Noted minor label change 'Enable Auto-Fallback' -> 'Auto Fallback (recommended)' to increase clarity. Will push to final assets.
Marcus Liu (Support): CS needs an FAQ draft and a triage decision tree for billing disputes related to cost breakdown exposure; assigned to @Daniel Ko to coordinate with Finance.
Daniel Ko (Assignee): Will publish training deck and recording links to Confluence by 2026-03-12; coordinating with SE to set up one customer pilot during canary phase.
shiproom_schedule: T-minus 24h: Final smoke and telemetry verification (owners: Eng Oncall, QA)
Launch Day - 00:00 UTC: Enable 5% canary via feature flag; monitor first 6h
Post-canary - 48h: Evaluate gates and decide on 25% expansion
GA: Final rollout to 100% with in-console announcement and blog post
training_plan: Live session 1 (UTC): 2026-03-10 16:00 — walkthrough of dashboards and rollouts UI, Q&A, recording
Live session 2 (UTC): 2026-03-12 09:00 — focused on cost breakdowns and billing implications for admins
Async content: 10-minute quickstart video + 25-minute deep-dive recorded session; hosted on Confluence
Audience: CS, Solutions Eng, Customer Admins, Developer Advocates
Deliverables: slide deck (PDF), 2 recordings, quickstart YAML for sample routes, FAQ + triage tree
comms_plan: Pre-announce to internal teams: 2026-03-11 — email + Slack #console-launch channel
Customer in-console banner: 2026-03-18 00:00 UTC — links to docs and training
Email to admins: targeted list for customers with >1 active route — 2026-03-18 01:00 UTC
Public blog post: 2026-03-18 08:00 UTC — highlights, screenshots, migration notes
Social/DevRel: co-ordinated posts after GA with how-to snippet and recording
observability_gates: p95_latency: must be <= baseline + 15% over a 6h window
error_rate: must remain < 0.5% sustained across routes
token_cost_per_request: must not increase more than 10% for canary cohort
cache_hit_rate: should be > baseline - 10% or we pause rollout
post_launch_tasks: 48-72h health review: capture telemetry trends and surface to exec dashboard
Customer feedback collection: coordinate CS for top-10 feedback items
Lessons learned doc and retro: publish within 7 days of GA
Billing reconciliation: Finance to validate cost-breakdown telemetry aligns with invoices
